top_signals.title: Investor Selby on Why Anthropic's IPO Puzzles Him
top_signals.summary: Copper Sky Capital Managing Director Jack Selby questions why Anthropic is rushing into the public markets when, in his words, the company has 'so much cash on their balance sheet, almost as much as Google'. He speaks on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Corrects the company name and Jack Selby's job title across the headline, description and throughout the video.) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Taylor Wimpey Sees Lower Profit as Mortgage Rates Squeeze Buyers
top_signals.summary: Taylor Wimpey Plc expects its operating profit to be at the lower end of consensus as higher mortgage rates and living costs weigh on UK home buyers.

top_signals.title: Man arrested over theft of watch that was returned days later to Tokyo mall
top_signals.summary: The ¥46 million wristwatch was returned to the store in Nakano Broadway via a delivery service on Nov. 1, along with a handwritten note of apology.

top_signals.title: Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
top_signals.summary: A threat actor used compromised identity and access management (IAM) credentials for a Qubole big data platform's AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple customers' AWS environments. [...]
